## History

Oliver Sloane gathered with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following the news that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) had painted the hall a bright blue. Together, the group shared in the collective dismay over the hall improvement project's sudden disaster.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032)_
